name: CreateGitAskPassScript
description: Writes a git credential helper that reads an access token from the environment, and sets GIT_ASKPASS.
author: Slawomir Koszewski

inputs.name: tokenEnvironmentVariable
inputs.label: Token environment variable name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name of the environment variable the generated script prints. The step that runs git maps the secret pipeline variable holding the token to this name with `env:`.

inputs.name: scriptPath
inputs.label: Script path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Where to write the script. Defaults to git-ask-pass in $(Pipeline.Workspace), with a .cmd extension on Windows agents.
